description: Kujiondoa kwa kuelekezwa kwa Cyber Background Checks. Mtu hufuata hatua kwenye orodha ya ukaguzi; OpenOptOut hutoa anwani ya barua pepe ya mara moja na kubofya kiungo cha uthibitisho.
instructions: Search cyberbackgroundchecks.com for {full_name}. If you're listed, open cyberbackgroundchecks.com/removal and remove the record, giving {contact_email} as the email address. Kisha bonyeza "Nimefanya hili".
